title: IntentSidecar
description:
PR-attached intent metadata sidecar (decomposition §1, item 4; B6④).

Non-authoritative (`authoritative` is always `false`); never gates
landing.

Frozen by WP-00.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria — a list of acceptance item descriptions.

authoritative.description:
Whether this sidecar is authoritative. MUST always be `false`;
non-authoritative by design.

charter.description: Human-readable charter / description of what the PR intends to do.

context_ref.description:
Content-addressed ref to the full context blob (may include diff,
prompt, rationale).

intent_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this intent (UUID or content hash).
